_about: Red flags for the example study. `rule` conditions are evaluated by backend/app/services/rules.py after every answer (DSL: item/derived + eq | in | gte | gt | lte | lt, combined with any/all). Flags with rule null are only raised when the agent calls report_red_flag or the post-call safety net finds them. Any red flag escalates at its level; false alarms are acceptable, misses are not. Symptom lists are condensed (not quoted) from the public US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only) and CDC fever guidance; lines marked 'Design decision' need clinical review before real use. `say_script` overrides the default urgent/emergency line. page_phrase_en is read to the nurse and must never contain names or other identifiers beyond the subject ID.

red_flags.agent_description: a temperature of 38.0 °C / 100.4 °F or higher, or a fever with shaking chills
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports a temperature of {temp_c} degrees Celsius.
sources: CDC, Watch Out for Fever (fever of 100.4 F / 38 C or higher during cancer treatment)
US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on fever or flu-like symptoms

red_flags.label_en: 7 or more stools a day above usual, blood or mucus in stool, black stool, or severe belly pain
red_flags.agent_description: diarrhea 7 or more times a day above their usual, blood or mucus in the stool, black tar-like stool, or severe belly pain
examples_en: there was blood in the toilet
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports {stools_over_baseline} stools a day above baseline{blood_note}.
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on intestinal problems

red_flags.label_en: Dizzy on standing with diarrhea or vomiting, or can't keep liquids down
red_flags.agent_description: feeling dizzy or lightheaded when standing up while also having diarrhea or vomiting, or not being able to keep liquids down
examples_en: I got dizzy when I stood up
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports dizziness on standing with diarrhea or vomiting, or cannot keep liquids down.
sources: Design decision by the team (clinical review pending)

red_flags.label_en: Short of breath at rest, severe shortness of breath, or new cough with shortness of breath
red_flags.agent_description: shortness of breath while resting, severe or worsening shortness of breath, or a new cough with shortness of breath
examples_en: I'm out of breath even sitting down
examples_es: me falta el aire aunque esté sentada
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on lung problems

red_flags.agent_description: struggling to breathe right now, unable to finish a sentence, or lips or face turning blue
examples_en: I can barely breathe right now
examples_es: casi no puedo respirar ahora mismo
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports severe trouble breathing right now.
sources: Design decision by the team (clinical review pending)

examples_en: there's a pressure in my chest
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on lung and heart problems

red_flags.label_en: New confusion, trouble speaking, unusual sleepiness, new tremor or balance problems, severe headache
red_flags.agent_description: new confusion, trouble speaking or finding words, unusual sleepiness or trouble staying awake, new shaking or balance problems, or a severe headache
examples_en: Dad keeps mixing up words since yesterday
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports new confusion, speech trouble or unusual sleepiness.
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on nervous system problems

red_flags.label_en: Seizure, fainting, or can't be woken
red_flags.agent_description: a seizure, fainting or passing out, or someone who can't be woken up
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports a seizure, fainting, or unresponsiveness.
sources: Design decision by the team (clinical review pending)

red_flags.label_en: Blistering or peeling skin, or painful sores in the mouth, nose, throat or genitals
red_flags.agent_description: blistering or peeling skin, or painful sores in the mouth, nose, throat or genitals
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports blistering or peeling skin or painful mouth sores.
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on skin problems

red_flags.label_en: Yellow skin or eyes, very dark urine, or much less urine than usual
red_flags.agent_description: yellow skin or eyes, very dark urine, or much less urine than usual
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, or decreased urine.
sources: US Medication Guide of an approved anti-PD-1 antibody (class only), section on liver and kidney problems

red_flags.label_en: New fast, pounding or irregular heartbeat
red_flags.agent_description: a new fast, pounding or irregular heartbeat
examples_es: el corazón me late muy rápido
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports a new fast or irregular heartbeat.

red_flags.label_en: Vomiting blood or bleeding that won't stop
red_flags.agent_description: vomiting blood or bleeding that won't stop
red_flags.page_phrase_en: Reports vomiting blood or uncontrolled bleeding.

red_flags.agent_description: thoughts of hurting themselves or not wanting to live
examples_en: I don't want to live like this anymore
